en: LTX: animate a picture to your audio. Speech and singing drive the video. An LTX model is selected automatically. Add the picture and recording, then describe the scene. The recording sets the video length; longer recordings use consecutive short parts. The picture sets the shape within the selected quality. The original audio is preserved in the result.
